claim_boundary: Authored synthetic static cases for the seven coordination agent families and the prepared, not admitted, coordination.debug_mirror_exported payload. They are not runtime captures, prove no native seglog, redb, lock, crash detector or append path, admit no family and grant no Event Authority, readiness or seal clearance. required_native_oracles are obligations that stay NOT_RUN.

evaluation.schema: Draft 2020-12 validation against the payload or projection definition, with the schema files and Plans/event_record_index_checkpoint.schema.json registered by $id and no remote retrieval. format is not asserted; calendar validity is the valid_utc_datetime rule.

static_rules.valid_utc_datetime: Every family timestamp is a real calendar date and time (CV-353 rule 5).
static_rules.identity_recipe: idempotency_key is coordination:{event_type}:{project_id}:{agent_id}:{recovery_epoch}:{agent_revision}, with the recovery epoch read as its second-to-last colon field and equal to the one the event_id uses, and event_id is evt_coordination_ plus the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 array of strings [storage_instance_id, recovery_epoch, project_id, event_type, agent_id, agent_revision] (SP-320).
static_rules.path_hash_recipe: path_hash is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of path_ref (SP-320).
static_rules.abort_ref_join: A parent abort has aborted_by_ref run:{parent_run_id} (CV-353 rule 6).

envelope_rules.project_only: scope_kind is project with a project_id (Contracts coordination scope).
envelope_rules.payload_envelope_identity: project_id, run_id and idempotency_key equal the payload's; thread_id and node_id equal the payload's or are null when it omits them; attempt_id is null (CV-353 rule 8).
envelope_rules.occurred_at_join: occurred_at_utc equals the payload's family timestamp.

admission_order: exact_retry: the same (scope_partition, event_type, idempotency_key) and producer digest returns the original event (exact_retry_original_result); a different digest is idempotency_conflict
family_admission: an event type outside admitted_event_types is quarantined_before_append
payload: schema, then the static rules

transition: registration existence (not_registered, already_registered), then the revision rule (stale_revision: agent_revision is not the agent's revision plus 1, expected_previous_revision is not agent_revision minus 1, or last_applied_event_id is not the agent's), then terminal (already_terminal), then lineage (lineage_mismatch)
change: coordination_unchanged when status and status_reason, the operation's summary, progress and refs, or the claim's kind, confidence and operation_id all equal the current rows
append: appended; the event_id follows the identity recipe
evaluation.producer_digest: For these fixtures the producer semantic digest is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON {event_type, payload}; an exact retry repeats the payload byte for byte.
evaluation.path_normalization: path_vectors apply SP-320's recipe lexically: no file system and no symbolic links. A path that leaves the worktree produces no claim.

transition_sequences.description: Registration, the initial operation at revision 2, status, a file claim, progress and the one terminal event; the claim is released at the terminal event and the operation row stays.
An update that skips a revision fails the revision rule and appends nothing.
No event of an unregistered agent is admitted.
A registration always has revision 1, so its idempotency key repeats: an exact retry returns the original event, and a changed payload is idempotency_conflict before the transition table is reached.
After the terminal event the next revision is refused as already_terminal.

Two terminal events race with the same revision: the first appends, the second fails the revision rule. A later terminal event at the next revision is already_terminal. Each agent has exactly one terminal event.
An update that changes nothing returns coordination_unchanged and advances no revision; the next real change uses that revision.
Later events repeat the registration's lineage: a different run_id, or a present node_id that differs, is lineage_mismatch; omitted optional lineage is allowed.
A newer claim by the same agent on the same path replaces the old one, an identical claim is unchanged, and the terminal event releases every claim.
Only coordination.agent_registered is admitted: a status update and a debug mirror export are quarantined before append, and nothing else changes.
The crash detector records heartbeat_expired with the observed age; the agent row shows failed.
A lost worktree is crash evidence; the agent row shows failed.
A parent abort names the parent run; the agent row shows cancelled.
An operation update that skips a revision is stale; the same update at the next revision after the crash is already_terminal.
A file claim that skips a revision is stale; a claim after the crash is already_terminal, so heartbeat expiry reaches claims only through the crash event.
A parent abort appends first; the racing unregister at the same revision is stale, and a later crash resolution is already_terminal.
A worktree-loss crash appends first; the racing runtime abort at the same revision is stale.
While the three terminal families are not admitted, their events are quarantined before append and the agent stays non-terminal; nothing infers a terminal state.
Operation, file claim and abort events are quarantined before append while their families are not admitted; the admitted families proceed and no sibling state is inferred.
Without an admitted registration family no agent exists: the registration is quarantined and an admitted status update finds no registered agent.
An exact retry returns the original event even after the agent has moved on.
The latest event for an operation_id wins; the first observation time is kept.

required_native_oracles.given: an admitted registration from the Orchestrator before node execution
required_native_oracles.required_result: one appended EventRecord and its first AppendReceipt; execution starts only after the receipt returns

required_native_oracles.given: a lost append acknowledgement for an admitted coordination event
required_native_oracles.required_result: storage.first_append_receipt.resolve.v2 returns the original receipt and original_append_result; no first mint and no second append

required_native_oracles.given: an uncertain append of an agent's event
required_native_oracles.required_result: the agent stays fenced: no later event for that agent until Storage resolves the original identity

required_native_oracles.given: a projector advance whose checkpoint changed after it was read
required_native_oracles.required_result: prior-value compare-and-swap fails; no row or checkpoint advances

required_native_oracles.given: a checkpoint advance, read and recovery
required_native_oracles.required_result: the stored nine-field durable token is joined to the live read's redb_snapshot_id and revalidated whole; an equal generation alone proves nothing

required_native_oracles.given: a crash resolution racing a normal unregister at the same revision
required_native_oracles.required_result: the first terminal event appends; the other gets coordination_conflict stale_revision and appends nothing

required_native_oracles.given: a verified restore of an older backup with non-terminal agents whose processes are gone
required_native_oracles.required_result: the crash detector resolves each with process_lost as a new operation; no lost or restored request is replayed

required_native_oracles.given: an event of a family that is not admitted
required_native_oracles.required_result: quarantined before append; no checkpoint advance; no sibling state inferred

required_native_oracles.given: agent liveness heartbeats and observations that change nothing
required_native_oracles.required_result: no heartbeat reaches the append admission; unchanged updates return coordination_unchanged; no heartbeat_expired crash until coordination_heartbeat_expiry_ms exists

required_native_oracles.given: a scheduler or prompt-context read while the checkpoint is not current, coverage is short or the publication changed
required_native_oracles.required_result: typed unavailable; the scheduler treats it as coordination_conflict and neither schedules nor injects context
writer admission cut off, current core withdrawn, projector and readers fenced, governed rebuild from kept seglog records; no seglog deletion

required_native_oracles.given: coordination records of a Run whose terminal canonical record has not resolved
required_native_oracles.required_result: not eligible for expiry under RP-COORDINATION-180D
never authority for scheduling, prompts, unregister, crash, abort, receipt or validation decisions
